headline: Executive order creates a new federal office called the United States Investment Accelerator.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new government body called the United States Investment Accelerator. Based on its title, the office appears meant to help speed up investment in the United States. No official summary was provided, so details such as which agency runs it, its exact duties, and its budget are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and investors planning to invest in the United States
who_it_affects.how: The new office may work with them on investment projects, though the specific services are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 31, 2025; no separate start date is given in the available material.
